task: Enhance POST /v1/settings/transfer to support type_of_integration filter (user_integrations, project_integrations booleans) and optional list of integration identifiers to limit transfer scope.

key_reasoning.reason: Three components touched: Pydantic request model (settings_transfer.py), FastAPI router call site (routers/settings.py), and SettingsTransferService (transfer() + _select_candidates()) — spanning API-model, router, and service layers.

Signature propagation from transfer() through _select_candidates() requires careful threading; unknown-identifier validation has no existing helper and must be authored; _partition copy-blocking must remain orthogonal to new setting_type filtering — these are moderate decisions with no exact precedent for the combination, but the advisory-lock and collision logic are untouched.

Five files modified: settings_transfer.py (model), routers/settings.py, settings_transfer_service.py, test_settings_transfer.py (router tests — all assertion signatures update), test_settings_transfer_service.py (9 TestTransfer tests need parameter updates plus new filter coverage). No new files needed.
